en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded parliamentary chamber during a formal session. The room is grand, with high walls, balconies filled with spectators, and elaborate lamps. A large bust of a woman, symbolizing the Republic, is visible on the left wall. Dozens of suited men occupy curved benches, while a speaker stands at a central podium. The scene captures the reading of the proclamation of the Republic at the inaugural session of the Constituent Assembly.
